headline: Polymarket halts trading after $2.5M crypto-drain breach; GitLab and Cisco ASA/FTD KEV deadlines Nov 1; Cisco SD-WAN attacks continue

bullets.text: New: Polymarket halted trading after a breach involving a crypto-draining script; BleepingComputer reports $2.5M has been traced.

CISA added GitLab CE/EE CVE-2026-97229 and Cisco ASA/FTD CVE-2026-76418 to its KEV list, both due 2026-11-01. An attacker already tried CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0) against Alpine Linux's GitLab; CVE-2026-76418 is being used to crash SSL VPN devices.
Attackers are exploiting Cisco SD-WAN flaw CVE-2026-20127 to deploy custom KeyDrift malware; the activity is tied to Volt Typhoon's 'Silent Train' network, used in four zero-day campaigns.

China-linked attackers used VMware ESX zero-day CVE-2026-41709, a low-severity logging flaw, to reduce audit trail visibility, while PHP2Shell and Fragnesia were chained to root firewalls. PHP2Shell is covered by seven outlets.

Exploitation attempts have begun against Oracle E-Business Suite RCE flaw CVE-2026-101767, days after Oracle patched it. Separately, attackers turned GitHub issues into a supply-chain campaign against 61 public repos in under an hour.

Breaches: UNM Health is restoring systems after a ransomware-claimed attack; Florida's education department says 4.9 million may be affected; new: Japan Airlines reports a third-party breach of passenger info; Belgium's tax agency pulled services offline.

actions: Patch self-managed GitLab CE/EE for CVE-2026-97229 before 2026-11-01 and check GitLab logs for exploitation attempts.
Apply Cisco's fix for ASA/FTD VPN CVE-2026-76418 before 2026-11-01 and review VPN logs and device crashes.
Patch Cisco SD-WAN for CVE-2026-20127 per Cisco's advisory and hunt for KeyDrift malware on SD-WAN components.
Apply your distro's kernel fix for CVE-2026-46300 before 2026-10-31; finish PHP updates for CVE-2026-109618/109619 (KEV due date passed).
Patch VMware ESX CVE-2026-41709 (KEV due 2026-11-11) and confirm Oracle's fix for EBS CVE-2026-101767 is applied.
Patch Adobe Commerce/Magento CVE-2026-48356 and Brotli CVE-2026-111497 by 2026-11-10; review Veeam and Juniper critical patches.
